problem_type: Chunked review loads the whole source before applying its bounded unit invariant
symptom: Final core-a review:branch fails before any model call with spawnSync git ENOBUFS for an 8106786-byte unified-80 diff.
direct_cause: chunkBranchDiff captures the entire range via execFileSync maxBuffer8064000 and only then splits patches into150KB units.
class_root: The boundary limiting review memory/input is downstream of an unbounded aggregate read, so total branch size prevents otherwise bounded processing.
affected_population: Large branches whose aggregate textual diff exceeds the Git capture buffer
A single enormous text file followed by other changed files; long UTF-8 diff lines
entry_points: Direct chunkBranchDiff callers used by original review tests
internal_only_reason: Internal ordering invariant proven by exact failing adapter/log and actual Git branch. Existing Node built-in fs/child_process and original packing/receipt mechanisms suffice; no dependency or protocol is introduced.
invariants: Git range diff is processed in bounded read buffers before model packing; aggregate or single-file size cannot overflow execFileSync stdout capture.
All changed file boundaries and binary summary remain represented. Original150KB per-model input limit,80 context lines,scope and explicit per-file truncation policy are unchanged.
Git failure propagates and never produces a pass receipt; private temporary resources are cleaned.

door_reduction.why_not: CLI range ingestion and existing Git metadata/receipt readers remain distinct legitimate operations; the check-handoff same-name local helper is unaffected. No second review owner is introduced.

generality_proof: The original single chunkBranchDiff owner reads every CLI/direct branch range through the same bounded ingestion, including multiple files, huge single files and UTF-8. No branch/path whitelist or buffer-budget increase.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Consume the Git range before original per-file makeUnit/packUnits without a whole-stdout capture.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: CLI uses this owner before invoking reviewChunk; original failing command and large real-Git regression exercise it.
Reads numstat/raw metadata rather than full binary bytes; existing binary summary is retained with original bound.
Door scanner matches a same-named local helper. It does not import the Ponytail reader or ingest its full branch patch.

recurrence.reason: Any future branch or individual file can exceed the fixed aggregate buffer before the existing chunker is reached.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs chunkBranchDiff runBranchReview runGit --roots=scripts; manually traced check-handoff same-name false positive.

prevention.invariant: Read large diff output through bounded ingestion before original per-file review units.
prevention.failure_mode: Git/I/O errors throw before receipt creation; no empty-diff or success fallback.
prevention.strategy: Replace the whole-stdout string dependency with native private temporary output and fixed-buffer patch parsing at the original owner. Retain declared oversize truncation with total byte reporting.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the eager aggregate textDiff/splitFilePatches path; keep one ingestion route and original review/receipt owners.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No new third-party dependency; Git and Node native process/filesystem APIs already power this script.

migration: No app data or user workflow migration. Old deferred receipt remains an honest failed-attempt record until actual branch review completes; no manual pass receipt or hook bypass.
residual_risks: Actual model availability and review content are separate from deterministic ingestion regression; real branch run still required.
Existing per-file150KB truncation policy remains and must stay explicit in review output.
Windows execution of this tooling change has not been verified.
Git metadata commands retain their existing bounded capture and fail closed for extreme path-count output; this repair removes full textual patch buffering, not every unrelated Git command bound.

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: The original range-to-review-unit owner must bound input before it packs units.
